# NEW 2026-11-22 v11.2 Worker 1: Celestial subjects, charter goals, zone names and track texts (oe_cel_, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v112_celestial_subjects.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Pacification commission charter: an overseas colony becomes a celestial pacification commission.
oe_goal_celestial_xuanweisi = {
	is_available = {
		scope:owner = { oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes }
		scope:target = {
			not = {
				any_location_in_province_definition = {
					controller ?= {
						not = { this = scope:owner }
					}
				}
			}
			any_location_in_province_definition = {
				would_be_overseas_for = scope:owner
			}
		}
	}

	default_priority = {
		value = 10
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:target = {
					any_location_in_province_definition = { is_city = yes count = 0 }
				}
			}
			scope:target = {
				ordered_location_in_province_definition = {
					max = 1
					order_by = best_capital_for_colony
					save_scope_as = new_town
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:new_town }
			scope:new_town = {
				change_location_rank = location_rank:town
				cc_setup_new_town = yes
			}
		}
		scope:target = {
			create_location_country_from_province_definition = {
				subject_type = subject_type:oe_cel_xuanweisi
				from = scope:owner
				capital = scope:new_town
				add_truce_with = {
					target = scope:owner
					mutual = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_select = {
		value = 100
	}
}

# Grand protectorate outpost: needs Kunyu advance (v11.2 W2); founds a grand protectorate in a zone the throne lacks.
oe_goal_celestial_duhu_outpost = {
	is_available = {
		scope:owner = {
			oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes
			has_advance = oe_cel_adv_sihai_duhu
		}
		scope:target = {
			not = {
				any_location_in_province_definition = {
					controller ?= {
						not = { this = scope:owner }
					}
				}
			}
			any_location_in_province_definition = {
				would_be_overseas_for = scope:owner
			}
		}
	}

	default_priority = {
		value = 20
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:owner = {
					any_subject = {
						is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu
						capital.area = scope:target.area
					}
				}
			}
			add = -100
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:target = {
					any_location_in_province_definition = { is_city = yes count = 0 }
				}
			}
			scope:target = {
				ordered_location_in_province_definition = {
					max = 1
					order_by = best_capital_for_colony
					save_scope_as = new_town
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:new_town }
			scope:new_town = {
				change_location_rank = location_rank:town
				cc_setup_new_town = yes
			}
		}
		scope:target = {
			create_location_country_from_province_definition = {
				subject_type = subject_type:oe_cel_grand_duhu
				from = scope:owner
				capital = scope:new_town
				add_truce_with = {
					target = scope:owner
					mutual = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_select = {
		value = 200
	}
}
